versions.content: The API request CanSM_RequestComMode (ref. to SWS_CanSM_00635 ) with the parameter ComM_Mode equal to COMM_SILENT_COMMUNICATION shall trigger the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_S_FULLCO M (ref. to Figure 7 - 1 ) with T_SILENT_COM_MODE_REQUEST , which corresponds to the function parameter network and the configuration parameter CANSM_NETWORK_HANDLE (ref. to ECUC_CanSM_00161 ).
